verdict.rationale: Factory documents persistent automations, Skills, Custom Droids and Markdown-defined output styles, but nothing in the pack shows versioning, review or rollback of those automations themselves. Its diff review and PR-review features apply to code changes, which is an adjacent capability. Keeping Markdown config files in git would be a user-side workaround, not a product feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
